theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cc_segment_current
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ∀ (P : ℕ) (a b : Euclid P), ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ g : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 0, S.boundary g = (g : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) b (fun i => i.elim0) - (g : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) a (fun i => i.elim0)) ∧ S.mass < ∞ ∧ S.support ⊆ segment ℝ a b
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
